description: The wallets observed paying one agent (income into its bound wallets, plus counted payments from other registered agents), up to 250, with payments, USD and first and last paid; and how much of its ERC-8004 feedback is payment-grounded (the reviewer paid the agent before rating it). Pass the addresses as clientAddresses to the Reputation Registry's getSummary to read only reviews from wallets that paid. Observed payers are a lower bound, and payment-grounded is not independent: a payer under the same operator grounds its own reviews.

agent.description: Base ERC-8004 token id, act_8453_N, or a ranked agent's slug or bound wallet

limit.description: How many payers to list (largest by USD first)

name: payer_set
title: Who paid an agent, and whether its reviews come from payers (free)
